g.text: Current matching core + fixed ESCO proxy

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52667b

g.text: Offline public relevance benchmarks Â· 18 October 2026

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #334b61

g.text: The measured component uses unconfirmed skill mentions and assumed candidate compatibility.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #506070

g.text: Whiskers: exploratory 95% query-cluster bootstrap intervals (10,000 resamples). Fixed jobs/raters/corpus; unadjusted for multiple comparisons.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #506070

g.text: TalentCLEF uses synthetic profiles and published positives only. MAP credits known relevant candidates; unlisted suitability remains unknown.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #506070

g.text: The ESCO adapter substitutes for confirmed skills; candidate preferences are assumed compatible and attention prices are zero.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #506070

g.text: This does not measure live allocation, reciprocal interest or hiring accuracy. The two panels measure different targets and are not interchangeable.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #748291
